messages:
maya: Heads up — want to schedule a dry-run demo combining LangChain chains, LlamaIndex retrieval stacks, our Gateway, and NVIDIA partner GPUs for the partner summit next month. Need alignment on scope, roles, and announcement timing. Who can own the runbook?
liam: I can take the infra runbook. Need a short checklist: model versions, quantization, batch sizing, and fallback path.
ana (sorry typo)
ana: small correction — it's ana :) I can own partner comms and the joint blog draft. Can you @liam share the infra checklist so I can map dependencies?
liam: putting a quick checklist here: 
```
- model: llama-3b-v1 (quantized int8)
- runtime: dedicated pool (4xA100)
- batch target: 4 requests / 50ms
- fallback: smaller model on CPU for failover
- metrics: p99 latency, tokens/sec, cost/tokens
```
chris: For orchestration (orch-toolchain) we should pin the gateway contract and a stable LangChain adapter commit. I'll add a small CI job to smoke test the end-to-end flow.
maya: Perfect. @chris can you add the adapter commit hash + orchestrator workflow link? Ana, once liam lands the infra checklist I'll draft the press/partner note.
chris: will do. Adapter hash: `git@github.com:redwood/adapter.git@r12f3c` — putting the workflow here: https://redwood.internal/ci/workflows/interop-dryrun (internal link)
liam: Quick note — need to coordinate with NVIDIA PM (sophia). She asked for a non-production SLO window and a security checklist. @ana can you pull in Sophie?
ana: sorry again, "ana" here — pinging @sophia from NVIDIA in the partners thread. Also can we set a code-free demo path for marketing — a simple chat + retriever example?
maya: Yes, two demo paths: 1) engineer demo (full trace + metrics) 2) marketing demo (single prompt -> retriever -> answer). Ana can lead marketing path.
ana: I'll draft the partner-friendly demo script and send to sophia + maya for signoff.
deploy-bot: Meeting scheduled: Dry-run coordination — Tue 10am PT — added to calendar for maya, liam, ana, chris, sophia (NVIDIA).
liam: Action items:
- liam: infra runbook + perf targets (due Fri)
- chris: CI smoke + adapter commit pinned (due Thu)
- ana: partner blog draft + marketing demo script (due Mon)
- maya: finalize demo scope, run the dry-run, postmortem template (due next Wed)
maya: Also need to decide announcement cadence. My proposal: internal dry-run -> partner preview -> public blog + joint tweet. Keep public announcement two weeks after dry-run. Thoughts?
chris: Sounds good. If dry-run exposes model quality regressions we push the public date. Also request a small A/B test with an older model variant behind a canary route.
ana: I'll add the announcement timeline to the draft and tag legal if needed.
liam: One blocker to flag: we currently don't have GPU quota reserved in the APAC region; if Sophia wants a regional demo we might need capacity request by EOD.
maya: Good catch. @sophia can you confirm region preference? If APAC, liam will file quota request and chris will adjust orchestration pool.
sophia (via ana): prefer US-west for summit rehearsals, but APAC local partner wants a replay — we can record the session and hand off.
maya: OK locking US-west. Final note: keep the external announcement language tightly coordinated — ana to run partner sign-off and legal check. Let's reconvene after the dry-run, add notes in the shared doc: https://redwood.docs/partnerships/toolchain-orch-dryrun (internal). :party-popper:
